verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at support.claude.com (HTTP 200) with a structured Markdown index of the Help Center, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The cited help-center article URLs are served as .md variants, which suggests agent-friendly Markdown pages, though a probe of the root /en/.md path returned 404. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or committing to the llms.txt/Markdown docs, an llms-full.txt or comprehensive agent-oriented docs bundle, a working root Markdown docs path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
